style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Employees who violate this Code, or who fail to report violations of which they are aware or style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Protection from Retaliation</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Shore United will not tolerate any retaliation for asking a question about this Code, making a good faith report of a suspected violation, or participating in the investigation of a suspected violation. Nor will Shore United tolerate retaliation for appropriate reports of any suspected legal or regulatory violation to any government authority or investigative agency.&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Reporting in good faith does not mean that you have to be right when you raise a concern or that the investigation must reach the conclusion that misconduct has occurred. Reporting in good faith means you have to believe that the information you are providing is accurate.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Retaliation is any adverse employment action or other action that is likely to deter a reasonable person from raising a concern, submitting a complaint, participating in an investigation, or engaging in some other form of legally protected activity. Allegations of retaliation will be investigated. Any employee who has been found to have engaged in retaliation in violation of this Code will be subject to appropriate disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Waivers</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You must request a waiver of a provision of this Code if there is a reasonable likelihood that your contemplated action will violate the Code.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In the case of executive officers or directors, any waiver must be approved by the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors. Shore United will disclose publicly any waivers granted to directors and executive officers to the extent required by law or the rules of the Nasdaq Stock Market.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The Chief Legal Officer has responsibility for interpretation of the provisions of this Code and their applicability. Any proposed waiver with respect to persons other than executive officers and directors must be approved by the Chief Legal Officer.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#c99700;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:18pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#006881;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:18pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Acting in a Manner that is Honest</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#006881;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:18pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">and Trustworthy</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Quality of Public Disclosures</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Shore United is committed to providing full, fair, accurate, timely and understandable disclosure in the filings it makes with any federal or state bank regulatory authority and the Securities and Exchange Commission and in its other public communications. You are expected to support this commitment by complying with our internal and financial control processes and using your best efforts to ensure that information you compile or maintain is accurate and complete.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Each of us is responsible for reporting any complaints or concerns relating to accounting, internal accounting controls, auditing matters or questionable financial practices. Consult our Whistleblower Policy on Shore Connect for additional information.</font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">4</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="margin-bottom:8pt;text-align:right"><font><br></font></div></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Accurate Recordkeeping and Reporting</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">As a publicly traded company, compliance with recordkeeping and reporting policies, procedures and controls is essential to meeting our legal and business requirements. All Shore United employees are responsible for maintaining accurate and complete accounting and financial records.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Most of us participate to some extent in recording, processing or analyzing financial or other information, or in the review and audit of these activities. These processes exist to assist in business decision-making and the evaluation of Shore United&#8217;s performance by Shore United&#8217;s Board, senior management and external auditors.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Never make, or ask others to make, a false or misleading entry or report. This applies whether the report is financial or non-financial or for internal or external use. Always record business transactions and payments accurately and in accordance with Shore United policies.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Document Retention</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Retention of certain records is required to meet our obligations to regulatory agencies, law enforcement and the lawful functioning of Shore United. Please familiarize yourself with and follow Shore United&#8217;s record retention policies and procedures that apply to your business function.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Our Records Retention Policy is available on Shore Connect&#47;Policies, Procedures &#38; Forms&#47;General.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Timekeeping</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Shore United compensates non-exempt employees for all hours worked. &#8220;Off-the-clock&#8221; work &#8211; when a non-exempt employee works without recording the time worked &#8211; is strictly prohibited. Managers should always require employees to accurately record hours worked. All employees who are required to keep time and attendance records must do so accurately.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Protecting our Assets</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Use of Shore United Assets</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Shore United&#8217;s assets are to be used exclusively in the pursuit of Shore United&#8217;s business except for minimal personal use authorized by your manager in accordance with other Shore United policies. Shore United&#8217;s assets include equipment, facilities, supplies, services such as telephones and computer networks, and the time and efforts of its employees. You should not use Shore United assets for personal gain or convenience, or make Shore United assets available for the gain or convenience of anyone else, or for any purpose other than conducting Shore United&#8217;s business unless you have management authorization to do so.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Authority to Make Commitments</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">5</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="margin-bottom:8pt;text-align:right"><font><br></font></div></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Only specific employees are authorized to make financial or other commitments on behalf of Shore United. Commitments might be such things as approving a loan or other extension of credit, ordering equipment or materials, authorizing business travel, approving payment of an invoice or expense report, authorizing budgets or budget overruns, signing leases or other contracts, selling assets, settling litigation or other claims, borrowing money, setting compensation or employee benefits, making charitable contributions and other transactions. These authorizations are governed by corporate policies. You may not make commitments on behalf of Shore United unless you have the authority to do so.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Use of Shore United Technology</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Technology assets provided by Shore United, such as personal computers, tablets and telephones, are Shore United property and are provided for business use. Each of us has a responsibility to protect these assets and the data that is on them from misuse, improper access, damage and theft. The unauthorized transmission of company data, access to inappropriate internet sites, and the transmission of inappropriate e-mails are examples of misuse of technology.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You may use Shore United technology for personal use, but any such use must be limited, reasonable and consistent with law and Shore United policy. Even where use of Shore United technology for limited personal use is permitted, such use is not private. Users of Shore United technology shall have no expectation of privacy or confidentiality in the use of these assets. Anything sent or received using Shore United technology may be reviewed by Shore United at its discretion.</font></div><div style="text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Handling Confidential Information</font></div><div style="padding-left:72pt;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Many employees learn confidential information in the course of their jobs and use it to perform important functions. It is vitally important that all employees handle confidential information properly.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">What is Confidential Information&#63;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">What follows is not a complete list of what is considered to be confidential information, but it illustrates what is typically confidential unless it has been disclosed by Shore United in a securities filing, press release, or other authorized formal or official public communication&#58;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Financial results, budgets or forecasts</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Business plans, operating plans, strategy statements, memos, operating manuals, organization charts and other internal communications</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Whether a product or business is meeting financial or other expectations</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;&#160;</font></div><div style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Business relationships or the terms of any business arrangement, including prices paid or received by Shore United</font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Client data such as client names and addresses or any confidential personal or business information of the client</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Advertising and marketing plans, campaigns and related expenditures</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Wages and salaries, bonus or compensation plans, and personnel changes</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Personal information about any employee</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In general, if information about Shore United has not been made public by Shore United, it should be treated as confidential.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Non-Disclosure and Non-Use</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You may not disclose to unauthorized persons any confidential information that you obtain as a result of your position with Shore United. This restriction on disclosure includes not only financial analysts and the press, but also business associates, family members and personal friends. It is a serious mistake to disclose confidential information to anyone simply because you are confident that that person will neither try to benefit from it nor disclose it to others.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You may use confidential information only for legitimate Shore United business purposes. Do not use confidential information for your own personal advantage or profit, for the advantage or profit of another, or to compete with Shore United.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Your obligations not to disclose Shore United&#8217;s confidential information and not to use it for unauthorized purposes continue after your affiliation with Shore United ends.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Privacy of Client Information</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Shore United is entrusted with important information about individuals and businesses. Our clients rely on us to maintain confidentiality and exercise prudence when dealing with their financial affairs. It is essential that you respect the confidential nature of this information. Do not attempt to access client information&#160;unless you&#160;have a legitimate business reason to do so.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Shore United is legally obliged to protect the privacy of a consumer&#8217;s personal financial information. Shore United&#8217;s privacy practices are set out in a privacy policy that is circulated to our clients and made available to the public. To protect client information, we have a responsibility to securely maintain all files and records. All employees are expected to adhere to Shore United&#8217;s privacy and information security policies.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Public Disclosures</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You may be asked for information about Shore United by the media, trade groups, consultants and others collecting information for various purposes. You should not make public statements on behalf of Shore United or provide confidential information in response to external inquiries unless you have been authorized to do so. If you receive a request to make a statement on behalf of Shore United, please contact our Marketing Department at&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">debra.rich&#64;shoreunitedbank.com</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Proper Disclosures</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">7</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="margin-bottom:8pt;text-align:right"><font><br></font></div></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Some employees must disclose confidential information as a part of their job responsibilities. This policy on confidential information is not intended to prohibit such authorized disclosures.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">A few examples of situations in which confidential information might properly be disclosed are&#58;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Disclosure of operational data to vendors or consultants in connection with providing services to Shore United</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Participation in legitimate and authorized industry surveys</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Providing data to governmental agencies as part of required filings</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">An authorized employee responding to media or financial analyst inquiries</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You should be certain that you understand what you have been authorized to disclose, and to whom, prior to disclosing any confidential information.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Insider Trading</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Shore United prohibits anyone who possesses material non-public information concerning Shore United from trading in Shore United&#8217;s securities. You must not communicate material non-public information to persons outside Shore United so that they may profit from transactions in Shore United&#8217;s securities. Material information is information that is likely to affect the market price of securities or that a reasonable investor would consider important in determining whether to buy, sell or hold a security. Information is non-public if it has not been disclosed in a manner designed to reach investors generally, such as in a publicly accessible conference call, a press release or in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Certain employees are designated as &#8220;restricted persons&#8221; and are subject to trading black-out periods and pre-clearance procedures. You will be notified by the Legal Department if you are designated as a restricted person and will be provided with additional information on the particular restrictions to which you will be subject.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Consult our Insider Trading Policy on Shore Connect for additional information on this subject. You should call the Chief Legal Officer with any questions about buying or selling Shore United stock.</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#006881;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:18pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Acting in the Best Interests of Shore United and our Clients</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#c99700;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:18pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Conflicts of Interest</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:14pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Each of us must carry out our professional responsibilities with integrity and with a sense of loyalty to Shore United. We are expected to make sound business decisions in the best interests of Shore United, without regard to our personal interests. A conflict of interest can arise when our judgment may be, or may appear to be, influenced because our personal or outside interests conflict with Shore United&#8217;s interests. Each of us is </font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">8</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="margin-bottom:8pt;text-align:right"><font><br></font></div></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">accountable for looking out for situations that may create conflicts of interest, avoiding them and reporting any situation that you think creates, or could appear to create, a conflict of interest. Conflict of interest situations that cannot be avoided must be disclosed and approved by the Chief Legal Officer or, in the case of executive officers or directors, by the Audit Committee of the Board of Directors.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Because it is impossible to describe every potential conflict, Shore United relies on each of us to adhere to the following principles&#58;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Never allow your judgment or actions to be compromised by personal interests.</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Always seek to make business decisions in the best interest of Shore United</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Bring conflicts or situations reasonably likely to lead to conflicts to the attention of your manager or the Chief Legal Officer</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Be mindful of how personal activities potentially can lead to conflicts</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">Proactively address situations that may put your interests or those of a family member in conflict with Shore United</font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font><br></font></div><div style="padding-left:144pt;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8226;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;padding-left:14.5pt">When in doubt, disclose to your manager or the Chief Legal Officer</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Personal Banking Transactions</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Many employees have accounts with Shore United and will need to conduct personal business from time to time. You may not monitor, originate or process transactions affecting your personal interest in a manner not generally available to clients. Personal interest transactions include those affecting your own accounts as well as those of your family members, business associates or close friends. You must transact all personal business through normal client-facing channels.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Self-Dealing</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You may not participate in business activities that compete with Shore United. If you discover a business opportunity through your position at Shore United, that opportunity belongs to Shore United and you may not personally participate in the opportunity.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Outside Employment</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">We understand that some employees may seek additional income from employment outside of Shore United. However, your outside interests must not compromise, or appear to compromise, your duties to Shore United. It is almost always a conflict of interest for you to work for a competitor, client or vendor of Shore United.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You must keep all outside business activities completely separate from your activities with Shore United. You may not use Shore United assets, facilities, materials or services of other employees for outside activities unless specifically authorized by Shore United, such as for volunteer work.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">All employees must obtain written approval before engaging in any outside employment, including self-employment. All requests will be evaluated to ensure no conflict of interest exists. Consult the Outside Employment Policy in our Handbook for Shore United Bank employees for additional information. Any time your outside employment changes, you </font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">9</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="margin-bottom:8pt;text-align:right"><font><br></font></div></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">should submit an updated Outside Employment Form on Shore Connect for Human Resources to review.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Outside Director, Officer and Trustee Positions</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Engagement in our communities is a core value of Shore United. We encourage and celebrate service to our communities.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Serving as an officer, board member or trustee of a local cultural, educational, social service or other non-for-profit organization does not generally require approval. However, we encourage you to discuss these roles with your manager. If you believe that a conflict may exist between serving with such organization and your role at Shore United, you should contact the Chief Legal Officer.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Serving as an officer or board member of a for-profit company or a governmental entity requires the approval of the Chief Legal Officer.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">When a transaction involving Shore United is discussed by an outside organization where you serve as an officer or director, you should disclose your relationship with Shore United and not participate in any discussion of or decision about the transaction.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Transactions with Shore United</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">A conflict of interest may exist when Shore United does business with an organization in which you or a family member has an ownership or employment interest. You may not conduct business on behalf of Shore United with family members or any organization in which you or a family member owns a significant financial interest or serves in an executive role.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">If a family member has a business that could provide services to Shore United, you may introduce the business to others at Shore United. You should also disclose your relationship. You may not do anything to influence our decision about engaging your family member&#8217;s business to provide services or be involved in our dealings with the business.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Transactions with Clients</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">All employees are encouraged to patronize our client&#8217;s businesses. However, you may not use your relationship with Shore United to receive special terms, price concessions or other special benefits.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You may not borrow money from a client, unless the client is a family member or other relative or the client is a recognized lending institution and then only on the same terms as generally available to the public.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">You may not lend personal funds to a client or co-sign, guarantee or otherwise assume responsibility for the borrowings of a client, unless the client is a family member or other relative.</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Inheritances and Fiduciary Appointments</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#160;</font></div><div style="padding-left:108pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Unless a client is a family member or personal friend whose relationship with you was established separate and apart from your employment with Shore United, you must try to discourage a Shore United client from leaving you an inheritance or appointing you as a </font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New
